verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a mobile app for search and capture on the go, and says search works offline on all devices with sync across them. However, its own docs call the mobile app "a companion to desktop," which contradicts the story's "not a stripped-down companion" requirement. Imports also require the desktop app. missing for 10: evidence of full knowledge-base parity on mobile, linking/backlinks/block references on mobile, named iOS and Android apps, hands-on corroboration of mobile depth.
